How it works

Ask. Understand. Fetch. Act.

ROCky sits between Teams, Slack or WhatsApp and the Qualys Enterprise TruRisk™ Platform, built on documented Qualys APIs and Qualys Agentic AI.

01AskText or voice in Teams, Slack or WhatsApp. Plain words, any time.
02UnderstandAI turns the question into intent and picks the right Qualys data.
03Fetch & reasonTruRisk, exploitability, exposure, ownership and patch status, combined.
VMDRETMCSAMPatch MgmtTotalCloud
04Answer & actA short card or chart with buttons to approve, patch or assign, and a secure link for the detail.

Use cases

Ask what matters. Qualys answers.

From the newest zero-day to the AI your teams adopted last week, every answer comes from your own Qualys data.

Did today’s zero-day hit us?
Detect. Prioritize. Auto-remediate.One conversation, from a new CVE to a patched estate.
1Detect · InstaScan“Did today’s zero-day hit us?”Exposure within minutes of disclosure, matched to your software inventory. No scan needed.13 min · 3 servers found
2Prioritize · TruConfirm“Which of these are actually exploitable?”Safe exploit validation on the live assets proves which findings are real, so teams fix those first.1 of 3 exploitable
3Auto-remediate · Wave patching“Patch it, safely.”ROCky rolls the patch out in waves of Qualys patch jobs, guided by the Patch Reliability Score, and holds the next wave if failures rise.3 waves · hold at 2%

Also in ROCky

TotalAI · Shadow AIWhat AI is running that we never approved?GenAI apps, self-hosted models, MCP servers and agents, found across endpoints, cloud and code.

Also in your AI assistant

Ask Claude or ChatGPT. The answer comes from Qualys.

ROCky also ships as an official Qualys MCP server. MCP is the open standard Claude and ChatGPT use to connect to company tools, so one server works in both, with the same rules as Teams and Slack.

Compliance first

Your security posture never leaves your control.

Built for enterprises with the strictest data rules, including US regulated industries and the public sector. The chat carries short summaries. Every detail opens in Qualys, behind your own single sign-on.
